name: Ananya Mehta
text: I ordered the Maison Noir Structured Tote for my work trips and it has completely replaced every other bag I own. The leather is extraordinary — it's been six months and it only looks better. The gold hardware hasn't tarnished even slightly. Worth every rupee.

name: Riya Singhania
text: The Lumière Evening Clutch was a gift to myself for my anniversary dinner and it stopped conversations. Three separate women asked me where it was from. The beading is so intricate — you can see the hours of work in it. Arrived beautifully boxed too.

name: Kavitha Nair
text: I was hesitant to buy luxury online but the WhatsApp enquiry process was so personal — they answered every question patiently. The Atelier Satchel arrived in 3 days, wrapped in tissue and a handwritten note. The quality matches anything I've bought abroad.

name: Priya Agarwal
text: Bought the Velour Mini Bucket Bag in Dusty Rose and it's perfect. The suede is incredibly soft and the leather trim is beautifully stitched. It's become my everyday bag for walks, errands, and lunches. Simple, beautiful, and feels expensive without being loud about it.

name: Shreya Kapoor
text: The Jade Slouch Hobo is genuinely the most complimented bag I've ever owned. The colour is so rich and unique — not something you see on every other person. The leather is getting better with age and the silver hardware has held perfectly. Maison Elara is the real deal.

name: Meera Chandran
text: Purchased the Elara Crescent Crossbody for my sister's birthday after a long search for something truly special. The moment she opened it, she said 'this looks like something from Paris.' Packaging was immaculate and delivery was faster than expected. Will definitely order again.
